Alisha (Marketing): Quick ask for next week's launch deck: need bench numbers + tiny reproducible payloads for demo. Specifically: p50/p95/p99 (ms), tokens/sec, model variant, and zipped request/response logs.
Mike (eng-runtime): Got it. Which configs? streaming vs non-streaming, seq len, concurrency, batch?
Alisha (Marketing): Two targets: 1) Live demo: streaming, ~512 tokens out, 1 concurrent connection, batch size 1. 2) Press stat: non-streaming, 128 tokens, simulate 4 concurrent users, batch sizes 1 and 8. Models: redwood-v2 (float) and redwood-v2-8bit (quant).
Raj (eng-runtime): We'll run each combo x3 and report medians + p95/p99, note instance (we'll use a100-40g), kernel hash, and quant pack. If variance >10% we'll mark unstable.
Alisha (Marketing): Also please include tiny curl + node snippets we can paste in slides.
Mike (eng-runtime): Curl (streaming example):

```
curl -s -N -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"model":"redwood-v2","input":"Summarize product updates","max_tokens":512,"stream":true}'
```

Node (non-stream): `await client.generate({model:'redwood-v2-8bit', input:'TL;DR', max_tokens:128})`

perf-bot: perf/smoke/1803456789 started on runtime-staging (a100-40g)
Mike (eng-runtime): We'll attach artifacts at runs/1803456789/{metadata.txt,requests.log,responses.log,methodology.md,summary.csv}. Methodology note will include CPU/GPU pinned state, kernel pack, and quant build id.
Sofia (Product): Legal: use phrasing like "typical p95 under X ms for the tested configuration" and footnote model/instance/kernel.
Mike (eng-runtime): ETA: artifacts + snippets by 10:30am PT tomorrow. If we see regressions we'll label them and DM Alisha.
perf-bot: perf/smoke/1803456789 finished: 12 jobs, 0 failures
Alisha (Marketing): Amazing, thanks team. I'll hold slide layout until you upload the artifacts. :thumbsup:
